$comment: feat.pharmacampus (FEAT-101) — the FDI-anchor facility catalogue for the pharma/R&D campus (Groton-Pfizer-class, §46 archetype; Pfizer's real UK campus was Sandwich, Kent) and the chemicals_complex comparison anchor. Spec refs: §46 Multinational Attraction & Anchor Employers (the archetype table: pharma R&D campus = 'university, graduates, clean utilities | labs: high-wage white collar, low freight'); §45 (supply-chain demand injection); §27 (the education lifecycle); §32 (closure shock / blight); §54 (money entering via FDI); resources-design-brief.md §6 (the Groton-Pfizer-class archetype). Balance-number regime: EVERY numeric figure below (footprint, output, jobs, utility draw, exports, capex, opex, wages, supply-chain counts, and the bid curve) is a PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass — no magnitude is final, and no AC may pin a specific number (feat.pharmacampus AC-2). This file extends the existing thin pharma_r_d_campus row in data/buildings.json (supplementCategory 'fdi-anchors', section SUP3, blightClass none, unlock M7) with per-type BEHAVIOURAL modelling only; blightClass/unlock/section stay single-sourced in data/buildings.json (GR#3).
